caption: On the free plan Zoviz showed 12 logo designs set with our business name, with filters for layout, colour and style.
One logo opened with its stacked layout and the options to continue or customise colours and fonts first; nothing was charged.
The same logo previewed on a business card, a social profile, a browser tab and a wall sign, and as a symbol from 96 down to 16 pixels.
The brand page as a draft: the logo versions are watermarked and the downloads stay locked until you unlock the brand kit.
The kit was already filled with our logo and colour: business cards, letterhead, email signature and social profiles.
Unlocking led to the plans on 22 Nov 2026: Starter €199, Pro €339 and Business €679 a year, or €29, €49 and €99 a month.
